name: launch-poof
description: Agent skill for Claude Code and Codex: writes a short text plus a copy-paste prompt for a friend's AI that finds their skills, plugins, rules and notes on a topic, redacts secrets, zips them and tells them how to send the kit to you. Includes a checklist for safely vetting what comes back.

interface.shortDescription: Get a friend's AI to package and send you their skills on any topic
defaultPrompt: Write a message and a prompt so my friend's AI sends me their Roblox skills and plugins.
